name: edit_file
description: Replace exact strings in a file, or apply multiple replacements atomically. Requires read_file on the same path first. Two modes: (1) Single - old_string + new_string replaces a unique match (fails if multiple matches unless near_line disambiguates). (2) Batch - edits array with multiple old_string/new_string pairs applied atomically. Prefer this over write_file for partial modifications; when filenames are known for multi-file tasks, go directly to read_file + edit_file per file. When asked to change something in a file, follow through with edit_file after reading - reading alone is not enough.

old_string.description: The exact text to find and replace. For multiple edits in one call, use the edits array instead.

near_line.description: When old_string matches multiple locations, pick the one nearest this line number.

replace_all.description: Replace ALL occurrences of old_string instead of requiring a unique match. Cannot be used with near_line or edits array.

edits.description: Multiple replacements applied atomically; all entries are validated before any change lands. Preferred over several edit_file calls on one file.
